cc:Work.dc:description: Two cards compare twenty epochs with one batch per epoch, giving twenty updates, against one hundred forty-two batches per epoch, giving two thousand eight hundred forty updates.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52645a
font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #234c3c

g.text: Same number of epochs. Different update counts.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52645a

g.text: A full-batch epoch takes one step; a mini-batch epoch takes one step per batch.

g.text: Mini-batch gradients are noisier estimates. More updates does not by itself prove better learning.
